title: Supreme Court's Birthright Citizenship Decision Exposes Rifts Among Justices, While Harvard Professor Leads New White House UFO Council
description: The Supreme Court's birthright citizenship decision has exposed sharp rifts among justices, while a Harvard professor with polarizing alien theories has been picked to lead a new White House UFO council. In other news, LeBron James has announced that he will not be returning to the Los Angeles Lakers, and Trump's financial filings have revealed that he took in about $1.2 billion from crypto businesses last year. A viral phenomenon in Argentina has seen young people identifying themselves as animals, and a runaway kangaroo named Sheila has shut down an Alabama interstate.
